text:
sam: deploy-bot detected p95 spike in EU canary after today's kernel flag flip. Auto-rollback queued. Holding because reserved-customer workloads share the pool. need quick decision. :grimacing:

deploy-bot: ALERT: eu-canary latency.p95 = 380ms (+38%). Auto-rollback in 3m unless acknowledged. slice=eu-canary, metric=latency.p95

li: Acking hold. Do not run global revert. Proposal: pin reserved-customer nodes to current commit, perform a small targeted revert (agent patch) on canary hosts only. Frank, can you run targeted list?

frank: Running `deployctl list --slice eu-canary --label reserved=false` now. Targets 4 hosts. I'll snapshot then run serial promote to v2.9.0-patch.

eli: I have a cherry-pick ready (patch: cp-2026-04-77) that reverts only the kv_cache optimization flag. PR will be small. ETA 10m to open.

deploy-bot: Auto-rollback suspended by user li. Manual actions required.

sam: Decision logged: pin reserved nodes to commit main@a1b2c3 for 24h, run targeted agent revert on non-reserved canary hosts. 2IC eli. Release-mgr, please add a short note to release notes.

release-mgr: Noted. I'll add: "Targeted revert applied to canary to address p95 regressions in EU; reserved nodes pinned. Post-mortem scheduled."

frank: Starting serial rollback. Commands: `deployctl promote --host eu-canary-01 --version v2.9.0-patch && wait-for-healthy` repeating. 1/4 complete.

deploy-bot: job=prom-4945-99 status=running progress=25% targets=4

frank: All 4 non-reserved canary hosts reverted. Monitoring graphs now. p95 trending back toward baseline after 7m. No error surge.

cs-contact: Customer briefed: "We're pausing the rollout for your pool and applying a targeted fix to stabilize latency. No action required on your side." They asked for follow-up post-mortem.

eli: PR #8841 opened for cherry-pick cp-2026-04-77 -> main. Includes test logs.

sam: Keep canary paused for two 15m windows. If stable, we can resume a slow ramp with the revert in place, or re-run rollout with different gating. Update runbook to include reserved-customer pin step.

release-mgr: Release notes updated and changelog linked to PR. Scheduling follow-up with ENG+CS tomorrow.

sam: Thanks all. Good call on targeted revert vs global rollback. We'll refine auto-rollback rules to check reserved pins next time. :white_check_mark:
